ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the raw product was ingested into the system

reportName.description: Base file name of the ingested APS report

reportFolder.description: Source folder or path where the report file was collected

satellite_id.description: Satellite unit identifier, derived from the Satellite column and normalized to an S-prefixed unit code

mission.description: Mission identifier, derived from the Satellite column and normalized to an S-prefixed mission code

doy.description: Day of year of the acquisition pass (from the DOY column)

downlink_orbit.description: Downlink orbit number of the pass (from the Downlink Orbit column)

antenna_id.description: Identifier of the antenna used for the pass (from the Antenna ID column)

antenna_status.description: Operational status of the antenna for the pass (from the Antenna status column)

front_end_id.description: Identifier of the front-end equipment used for the pass (from the Front End ID column)

front_end_status.description: Operational status of the front-end equipment (from the Front End status column)

planned_data_start.description: Planned start time of the data acquisition (from the Planned Data start column)

planned_data_stop.description: Planned stop time of the data acquisition (from the Planned Data stop column)

first_frame_start.description: Time of the first acquired frame (from the First Frame start column)

last_frame_stop.description: Time of the last acquired frame (from the Last Frame stop column)

delivery_push_status.description: Status of the delivery push for the pass (from the Delivery Push status column)

start_delivery.description: Start time of the delivery (from the Start Delivery column)

stop_delivery.description: Stop time of the delivery (from the Stop Delivery column)

number_of_chunks.description: Number of chunks delivered for the pass (from the Number of chunks column)

overall_data_volume.description: Overall data volume of the pass (from the Overall Data Volume column)

overall_number_of_downlinked_frames.description: Total number of downlinked frames (from the Overall Number of downlinked frames column)

overall_number_of_bad_downlinked_frames.description: Total number of bad downlinked frames (from the Overall Number of bad downlinked frames column)

fer_downlink.description: Frame Error Rate for the downlink (from the FER_Downlink column)

overall_number_of_data_acquired_frames.description: Total number of data-acquired frames (from the Overall Number of data acquired frames column)

overall_number_of_bad_data_acquired_fram.description: Total number of bad data-acquired frames (from the Overall Number of bad data acquired frames column)

fer_data.description: Frame Error Rate for the acquired data (from the FER_Data column)

notes.description: Free-text notes about the pass (from the Notes column)

interface_name.description: Interface that provided the product, set to a per-station constant (e.g. DDP_S5P-DLR_DAILY, DDP_INS-Inuvik)

production_service_type.description: Production service type, set to the constant DDP

production_service_name.description: Production service name, set to a per-station constant (e.g. S5P-DLR, INS-Inuvik)

ground_station.description: Ground station identifier, set to a per-station constant (e.g. DLR, INS)

report_type.description: Type of the report, set to the constant daily
